args.body:
Migration report: all 10 batches (400 records) ran. Batches 1-10 each reported 40 records migrated.

ISSUE: Phone numbers are wrong for overseas customers. The old CRM stored numbers without country codes, and the new CRM saved every number with a +1 prefix. In batch 3, 31 of 120 records are overseas, and the validation note says batches 4-10 likely have the same problem. I have not checked how many overseas records are in batches 4-10.

Impact: 14 sales users opened customer records in the new CRM in the last 24 hours, so they may already be using bad phone numbers.

I have not changed any phone numbers. I don't have the correct country codes, and bulk edits could cause more errors. Recommended next steps:
1. Decide whether to pause sales access to the new CRM until phones are fixed.
2. Provide the country code source (or confirm the old CRM data) so phone numbers can be corrected.
3. Let me know if you want me to correct the affected records once the codes are confirmed.

events.text:
The migration is finished, and I sent you the report.

All 400 records in 10 batches migrated. However, the new CRM saved phone numbers for overseas customers with a +1 prefix, so those numbers are wrong. Batch 3 has 31 affected records out of 120, and the validation note says batches 4–10 likely have the same problem. I haven't counted those yet. Fourteen sales users opened customer records in the last 24 hours, so some may already be using the bad numbers.

I haven't changed any phone numbers, because I don't have the correct country codes. Once you confirm where those codes come from, I can correct the affected records. You may also want to decide whether to pause sales access until the phones are fixed.
